tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Returns the URL to book a live demo of Dash0 with the team.

tools.name: get_api_docs
tools.description: Returns the Dash0 API reference documentation URL. Covers endpoints for ingesting OTLP logs and spans, managing alerting rules, check rules, and other platform operations. Also returns the OAuth 2.0 discovery endpoint for programmatic authentication.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Returns the Dash0 documentation base URL and a list of top-level sections covering getting started, telemetry, dashboards, monitoring, alerting, AI/MCP, cost control, integrations, and miscellaneous settings.

tools.name: get_mcp_connection_info
tools.description: Returns information on how to connect an AI assistant to Dash0 via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including the transport type, endpoint pattern, and authentication method.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the Dash0 pricing page URL. Dash0 uses usage-based pricing with a free tier.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Dash0 website for documentation, blog posts, integrations, and product information. Returns a URL to the search results page.
